# privacy-allowlist.txt - justified hits for .github/scripts/check-privacy.js.
#
# Format (one entry per line, fields separated by " | "):
#   rule | path-glob | line-regex (or - for any line) | one-line justification
# rule is notebook|email|userpath|key|term or * for all. Path globs are repo-relative;
# "*" stays inside a path segment, "**" crosses segments. Keep every entry as narrow
# as it can be: a path AND a line regex whenever the hit is a single known line.
# A new entry needs a real justification, not "it was already there".

# The check defines the terms it looks for; the changelog documents their removal.
term | .github/scripts/check-privacy.js | - | defines the C4 term list and self-test plants
email | .github/scripts/check-privacy.js | jane\.doe@gmail\.com | self-test plant (fictional address)
userpath | .github/scripts/check-privacy.js | /Users/janedoe | self-test plant (fictional path)
term | CHANGELOG.md | - | release notes name what was purged from the tree (the removal itself is the record)
userpath | CHANGELOG.md | /Users/Tekki | release notes quote the personal path that was removed from five files

# Class D ruling (SYNC-BRIEF C4): existing prose in these two trees is exempt and untouched.
# New personal lines must not be added there; this only grandfathers the current text.
term | core/memory/lessons/** | - | Class D: grandfathered lessons prose, exempt from the C4 term rule
term | agents/critiques/memory/** | - | Class D: grandfathered critique memory, exempt from the C4 term rule
